evals.prompt: /triage show me anything that needs my attention
evals.expected_output: Queries the tracker and presents three oldest-first buckets (unlabeled, needs-triage, needs-info with reporter activity) with counts and one-line summaries, then lets the maintainer pick.
expectations: Presents exactly three buckets: Unlabeled, needs-triage, and needs-info with reporter activity since the last triage notes
Orders items oldest first and shows counts plus a one-line summary per item
Uses the configured label mapping (from setup) rather than assuming label strings, or notes to run /setup-matt-pocock-skills if missing
If PRs are in scope, only includes external PRs and tags each line [PR] or [issue]
Stops to let the maintainer pick an item rather than triaging everything automatically

evals.prompt: /triage let's look at #87 — reporter says 'CSV export drops rows with emoji in the name'. No labels on it yet.
evals.expected_output: Reads the issue, checks for redundancy and prior rejections, recommends category+state and waits, then tries to reproduce before any grilling, and posts outcome comments with the AI disclaimer.
expectations: Runs a redundancy check (searching for existing handling by domain concept) and reads .out-of-scope/*.md for prior rejections
Recommends one category role (bug) and one state role with reasoning, then waits for maintainer direction
Attempts to reproduce the bug from the reporter's steps and reports confirmed / failed / insufficient detail before any grilling
Any comment posted starts with '> *This was generated by AI during triage.*'

If moved to ready-for-agent, posts an Agent Brief (category, summary, current/desired behavior, key interfaces, acceptance criteria, out of scope) without file paths; if needs-info, uses the 'Triage Notes' template with 'What we've established so far' and specific questions for the reporter

evals.prompt: /triage #133 asks for a dark-mode toggle in the dashboard. We decided we're not doing theming. Close it out.
evals.expected_output: Treats it as a rejected enhancement: records it in .out-of-scope/ (one file per concept), comments with the AI disclaimer linking that record, labels wontfix, and closes.
expectations: Classifies as category enhancement with state wontfix (rejected, not already-implemented)
Writes or updates a concept file in .out-of-scope/ (e.g. .out-of-scope/dark-mode.md) explaining why theming is out of scope, appending to an existing file if one covers the concept
Posts a closing comment that begins with '> *This was generated by AI during triage.*' and links to the .out-of-scope record
Confirms the planned actions (role changes, comment, close) with the maintainer before acting, treating it as a direct override without grilling
